verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform for software vendors, so agent-initiated checkout is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers API keys, payment intents, webhooks, onboarding, pricing, payouts and disputes. Nothing in it mentions agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials, or agent-initiated checkout on split-funds marketplace transactions.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform is ready for agent buyers — documented support for agent-initiated checkout on marketplace transactions (agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials) that works with split funds flows
